compliance.title: Compliance
compliance.answer: Your role does not read the certificates yet.
compliance.info: The Owner gives this right with the other rights at the walk. Until then this tab only says why.
compliance.body: The CE class and the label are on the Overview's Product facts.

revisions.title: Revisions
revisions.answer_one: {count} revision. A released revision is frozen: a change goes into the next one.
revisions.answer_other: {count} revisions. A released revision is frozen: a change goes into the next one.
revisions.info: Every revision of this product. Orders use the released one.
revisions.held: Comparing two revisions and their changes needs the materials right.

sheet.subtitle: {code} · product sheet
sheet.inMm: Finished measurements of each size, in millimetres.
sheet.noHowTo: No words for this point yet.
sheet.noPrice: This sheet never shows a price.

answer.noOrders: No open order uses it yet.

design.title: Design
design.answer: The main pictures, front and back.
design.none: No design picture yet. Add pictures in Variants and markets below.
design.info: The main picture of the gallery and the next one. The Product sheet puts them on one A4 page, never with a price.

facts.title: Product facts
facts.readOnly: Read only: your role reads this product.
facts.info: The fixed facts of this product. Product facts change with the right to manage products; the designer changes them while the newest revision is a draft.

release.title: Before release
release.archived: This product is archived: it cannot be ordered.
release.info: What a draft still needs before it can be ordered. Press r to open the check.

prices.title: Agreed prices
prices.answer_one: {range} for one piece, from {count} agreed price.
prices.answer_other: {range} for one piece, from {count} agreed prices.
prices.notRead: The agreed prices are not read yet.
prices.info: The lowest and the highest price agreed with the customers for one piece. The price comes from each customer's agreed prices, never from the product.

made.title: How it is made
made.info: The departments this product goes through. The production manager sets the route on the Route tab.

used.title: Where it is used
used.none: No open order uses it yet.
used.info: The open orders with this product: delivered, closed and cancelled orders are left out.

variants.title: Variants and markets
variants.answer: {colourways} colourways, {skus} SKUs. Also the markets, GTINs, pictures, names per language, private label and lifecycle.
variants.info: Colourways and sizes, the SKU matrix with its GTINs, the markets it is sold in, the pictures and the product's other details. Closed to keep the page short.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.info: The sizes this product is made in and the base size the size table starts from. The Sizes tab holds the size table, how to measure and the protectors.

answer.rangeMtm: {from} to {to}. The base size is {base}. Made to measure too.
answer.rangeMtmNoBase: {from} to {to}. No base size yet. Made to measure too.
answer.mtm: Made to measure. Each piece is cut to the rider's measurements.
